R7AA-grouse-atv-0001.name: 1.1 km E of Chedakuz Creek
R7AA-grouse-atv-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7AA-grouse-atv-0001.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
10 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 6 table (pages 50 and 51), so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis).

plan: Drive: from District of Vanderhoof, about 128 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 53.22703, -124.65555, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 260 m to the start. Ride: the unnamed road stretch, 3.1 km one way. About 63 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-1, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-06, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AA-grouse-atv-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-1: about 1,996 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.35 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.3 km and about 8 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).

R7AA-moose-backcountry-0005.name: 2.0 km S of Kluskus Lakes
R7AA-moose-backcountry-0005.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AA-moose-backcountry-0005.parkWhat: pull off on Coglistiko River FSR (gravel road)

evidence.t: 13 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 0.3 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2018 (8 years old), right here: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: North Chilcotin. Closed September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 4-3/23.

Camp: flat ground 150 m E of the spot at 1,234 m (53.05319, -124.55201). Water: unnamed wetland 60 m SW (estimate).
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
